_note: House answers for the video menu. A new video starts with these, marked from: defaults, until each is confirmed. Items 1 (job) and 2 (sources) are each video's own. Change a value here with its reason and every new video picks it up.

layout.reason: The screen at native pixels fills the frame; text is large; the explanation is a card beside its element. The review of earlier work found text slides read as empty and an inset screen as three quarters of the frame.

brand.reason: No brand until one is applied through vkit brand; the theme defaults render.

look.reason: Modern whiteboard, marker on charcoal. The studied looks are offered once looks/ is filled.

tone.reason: One accent, no grain, cuts rather than glides, longer holds. Capability stays; restraint is a setting.

patterns.reason: The measured moves closest to a walkthrough and a definitions opener.

voice.reason: Clips per part, measured, are the clock; captions as a file; no bed so a pause stays available.

characters.reason: Off when the tone is formal.

fixed_lines.reason: A series card after the opening hook; one before it delays the reason to watch.
